audit_items.proof_trace: All three sub-conditions hold. (1) price > 0 is enforced by get_magnitude_if_positive() abort on negative, division-by-zero abort in assert_price_conf_within_range if price_value=0, and an explicit assert in normalize_decimals, plus a re-check in check_price at read time. (2) Staleness is doubly enforced: PRICE_FEED_DELAY_SECONDS=30s at write time and price_delay_tolerance_ms (default 5s) at read time. (3) Flash loan / single-tx manipulation is prevented because Pyth prices are off-chain VAA attestations that on-chain flash loans cannot influence; the default consumer path uses EMA (smoothed over many updates) and confidence-interval validation rejects anomalously wide price bands.
